title: Coach dashboard
lead: One row per student: the last 7 / 28 days' volume, load, next race, schedule completion and last sync. The numbers are computed after each of the student's syncs, after they change a race or the schedule, and every night; this page only reads, it never changes a student's data.
empty: No students yet. Make an invite link on the Coach tab of Settings; a student who accepts it shows up here.
not_coach: Only coaches can see this page. Ask the admin to make you a coach.
summary.none: The first summary is being computed; it shows up within minutes
summary.refreshing: Race or schedule just changed; updating…
plan.d28: {done} of {due} done in the last 28 days
sort.label: Sort
red.none: No student has a red alert right now.
